name: Parameters.nonempty_infinitePlace_equiv_finPlace
summary: Fix w above p. The map v ↦ (v • w or its conjugate, whichever contains a) is a bijection: the action of Φ on the places above p is simply transitive up to conjugation, and exactly one of a place and its conjugate contains a.

steps.claim: Fix a finite place w of E above the prime p (`FinPlace.exists_natCast_mem`).
steps.lean:
↑p ∈ w.1}) := by refine (FinPlace.exists_natCast_mem _ p).rec fun w _ ↦
  ⟨.ofBijective (fun v ↦ ⟨ite (a ∈ (v • w).1) (v • w) (star (v • w)), ?_⟩)
  ⟨fun u v ↦ have : v • w = (u⁻¹ * v) • u • w := by ext; simp [galOfPlaceInt, smul_smul]
  ?_, fun _ ↦ ?_⟩⟩ <;> grind [mem_star_place, star_mem_iff, mem_smul, map_natCast, star_natCast,
  exists_smul_eq_or_star, star_star, smul_ne_star, smul_eq_self_iff_eq_one, inv_mul_eq_one]

steps.claim: The map: v ↦ v • w if a ∈ v • w, and v ↦ conj(v • w) otherwise; that its value contains a and p is left as a goal; to be shown bijective.
Injectivity: let u, v ∈ Φ have the same image.
steps.lean:
⟨fun u v ↦ have : v • w = (u⁻¹ * v) • u • w := by ext; simp [galOfPlaceInt, smul_smul]
  ?_,

steps.claim: v • w = (u⁻¹v) • (u • w), since Φ acts through the group Gal(E/K).
steps.lean: have : v • w = (u⁻¹ * v) • u • w := by ext; simp [galOfPlaceInt, smul_smul]

steps.claim: The injectivity goal itself is left open (closed in 1.4).

All open goals: exactly one of v • w and conj(v • w) contains a (`star_mem_iff`), and both contain p; if u and v have the same image, then u • w and v • w are equal or conjugate — conjugate is impossible (`smul_ne_star`), equal means u⁻¹v fixes w, so u = v (`smul_eq_self_iff_eq_one`); a place w′ ∋ a, p is v • w or conj(v • w) for some v (`exists_smul_eq_or_star`), hence the image of v.
steps.lean:
<;> grind [mem_star_place, star_mem_iff, mem_smul, map_natCast, star_natCast,
  exists_smul_eq_or_star, star_star, smul_ne_star, smul_eq_self_iff_eq_one, inv_mul_eq_one]
